Revenue from Kokubu Group Corporation, the main customer, was ¥5,126 million, accounting for 10.3% of consolidated revenue.
entries.210aeee2f14590f5: Its long-term vision toward fiscal 2033 sets as its ideal image for ten years from now “a company that creates food categories through deliciousness, enjoyment and newness,” and it is promoting the three-year medium-term management plan “Ebara Reboot 2026,” treating the first three years (fiscal 2024 to 2026) as steps for investment execution and structural transformation. Through “structural transformation” and “growth investment,” it makes building revenue through appropriate allocation of management resources its key policy, and its basic strategies are: “refine existing businesses and domains and pursue higher profitability,” “establish a new growth trajectory through new markets and new value creation,” and “deepen management base reforms not bound by conventional frameworks.”
entries.247b3e50fc424d6d: The company, together with 11 consolidated subsidiaries and one equity-method affiliate, forms a group that manufactures and sells meat-based seasonings, hot pot seasonings, vegetable-based seasonings, soups and other products.
entries.320953e0cf97f64d: This is a product group for business customers such as the food service industry. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥11,545 million, composed of meat-based seasonings ¥3,264 million, soups ¥3,680 million, and other ¥4,600 million. Representative products include "Ogon no Aji," "Yakiniku no Tare," "Yakitori no Tare," ramen soup and Gara Soup.
entries.371ef38408080960: This is a product group sold to households through mass merchandisers, convenience stores and similar outlets. Representative products include "Ogon no Aji," "Yakiniku no Tare," "Petchi Nabe," "Asazuke no Moto" and "Yokohama Hakurai-tei Curry Flakes."

entries.47f637e3739764bc: As challenges for fiscal 2026, the final year of the medium-term management plan, it cites expanding market share of core products such as portion seasonings, rebuilding its business model linked to the restructuring of its domestic manufacturing system, technology development and commercialization aimed at creating new brands and categories, and organizational preparation for growth in overseas business.
